author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at Night Shift: 1999 in this trailer for the upcoming narrative-driven visual novel set in the dying hours of the millennium. You play as Isra — a vampire trying to hold onto something resembling a normal life while the world, and your instincts, begin to fray. Night Shift: 1999 will be available on PC.

Work the night shift. Build relationships. Make choices that matter. But hunger doesn’t negotiate. Will you hold the line…or become what you were always meant to be?
title: Night Shift: 1999 - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Gameplay Trailer for It's About Pirates, an action bullet-hell pirate roguelike developed by Elderwoof Games. Players will take to the high seas to attain powerful items, plunder loot, and craft a build worthy of battle. It's About Pirates is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: It's About Pirates - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out action-packed gameplay from Havkerman-X in this new trailer for the upcoming open world, post apocalyptic, first-person shooter sim game. Havkerman-X features high-risk/high-reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland. Havkerman-X will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Havkerman-X - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the Island Beekeeper announcement trailer for this upcoming cozy co-op game for up to 4 players, where you and your friends build and grow your own beekeeping operation on floating islands. Island Beekeeper will be available on PC. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3968160/Island_Beekeeper/

In Island Beekeeper, build your apiary on islands above the clouds, travel on your medocycle, crossbreed bees with unique traits and create a cozy home in the sky. Grow plants, explore islands and send healing honey down to Earth, where people still hope for your help.
title: Island Beekeeper - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Video for Tsarevna: Age of Tales, an upcoming action hack-and-slash game developed by Watt Studio. Players can get a look at nearly five minutes of gameplay from the upcoming title, featuring acrobatic-based combat, flashy combos, and hordes of enemies to dispatch. Go for the high score in Tsarevna: Age of Tales, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Tsarevna: Age of Tales - Official Gameplay Video

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Blood Vial, a retro-inspired action boomer shooter developed by Dillon Steyl. Players will fight through enemy after enemy with a continuously depleting health bar. Swim in the blood of the fallen to keep the vial full, attain upgrades, and traverse sprawling crypts, catacombs, and cathedrals alike. Blood Vial is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Blood Vial - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Trailer for King's Deck, a roguelike strategy tower defense game developed by M. Ensar Sandıkçı. Players will assemble a deck to defend their kingdom from attackers. Deploy units, create powerful synergies, and survive waves of enemies. King's Deck is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: King's Deck - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Valken, a realistic tactical action shooter developed by Revane Studio. Players will embody a lone soldier on a mission to infiltrate a secretive military organization with no backup. Dive into a tense story campaign or a zombie extraction mode to save survivors from a deadly contagion. Valken is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Valken - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Official Trailer for Ram Fights, a physics-based comedic brawler developed by Doomers Entertainment. Players will customize their very own gladiator animal to charge into competitors and headbutt them into oblivion. Master the charge in Ram Fights, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Ram Fights - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Test of Time Announcement Trailer for Civilization 7, a strategy-based city-building game developed by Firaxis Games. Players can soon access an incoming update with Test of Time, packed with changes and new additions to the core gameplay based on player feedback. Test of Time is fitted with a reworked Victory system, 90 new objectives, upgraded map generation, and more to explore. The Test of Time Update launches on May 19 for Civilization 7 on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Civilization 7 - Official Test of Time Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Year 3 Teaser Trailer for Skull and Bones, the hit naval-based action open-world game developed by Ubisoft. Players can get a taste of what's to come with Year 3, offering new large ships, new loadouts to take advantage of, and greater challenges to overcome on the open seas. Year 3 for Skull and Bones kicks off on May 12 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Skull and Bones - Official Year 3 Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Teaser Trailer for A.A.U. Black Site, a first-person psychological action shooter developed by Raspberry Studio. Players will embody a member of the covert A.A.U. Special Forces to come to terms with a routine mission that goes wrong. Traverse an array of different environments, wield an arsenal of weapons, and discover the nature of the Black Site. A.A.U. Black Site is launching into Early Access on May 21 for PC (Steam).
title: A.A.U. Black Site - Official Release Date Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Only Humans On Board announcement trailer for this upcoming job simulator game. Buy supplies and manage your resources. Serve customers quickly from your trolley, but stay sharp: be aware of the unknown. Some passengers are only pretending to be human. 

Only Humans On Board will be available on PC.
title: Only Humans On Board - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Legacy Chronicle Trailer for Hunt: Showdown 1896, a first-person extraction shooter developed by Crytek. Players can progress through the new Legacy Chronicle by completing challenges, earning sigils, and unlocking cosmetic rewards for character and weapon skins to use in-game. The Legacy Chronicle for Hunt: Showdown 1896 is launching on May 13 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Official Legacy Chronicle Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Welcome Demon announcement trailer for this upcoming decision-based management game where you play as a Warden of a prison beyond all worlds. Each day, demons arrive, confess their sins, and you decide where they belong. Welcome Demon will be available on PC.

You are a dungeon warden. Sitting in the chair of the previous warden you killed, you must cleanse yourself of your sins within 666 hours. Place the incoming demons into six different dungeons based on your information, intuition, and limited resources.
title: Welcome Demon - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the announcement trailer for The Jackbox Party Pack 12, which features five new party games. The Jackbox Party Pack 12 will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Apple TV, iPad, and the Mac App Store in 2026.

The Jackbox Party Pack 12 will follow up on 2025’s Party Pack 11 with five different games designed to take your party to new heights. Highlight your inner artist, comedian, mind reader, debater and team captain like the life of the party you are. Is it social manipulation if you’re trying to make people laugh? That’s for your friends and loved ones to decide.
title: The Jackbox Party Pack 12 - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at gameplay and more from Quantum Quartz in this latest trailer for the upcoming steampunk pixel-art precision platformer game, where you toggle platforms on and off using colored crystals. With only one active at a time, each grants a different movement ability, changing how you move and how the level works, blending high-skill platforming with spatial puzzles. Quantum Quartz will be available on PC in 2027, and a demo is coming to Steam in June 2026.
title: Quantum Quartz - Official Demo Announce Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the City Showcase Trailer for The Guild: Europa 1410, a sandbox strategy RPG developed by Ashborne Games. Players will rise above the rest in medieval Europe by way of mastering their profession. Get a look at the scenic views around the city in The Guild: Europa 1410, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The Guild: Europa 1410 - Official City Showcase Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the latest WheelMates trailer for this upcoming co-op adventure game, where two drivers guide tiny RC cars through the secret-riddled house of an eccentric missing scientist. WheelMates will be available on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. A demo is out now on Steam. In the demo, you'll explore the Garage after learning the controls and using the first power-ups in the Kitchen. The Garage is a big open space full of hidden paths, offers new tools to use, and more secrets to discover. Unleash gear like magnet grab and rope swing to solve puzzles together, find secret areas, and discover the whereabouts of the professor.
title: WheelMates - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Payday Collaboration Gameplay Trailer for PUBG: Battlegrounds, the hit third-person action battle royale game developed by PUBG Corporation. Players can experience the new PvE heist mode inspired by Payday that permits players to become thieves. Infiltrate secure locations, fight back against resistance forces, and leave with precious valuables. The Payday PvE heist mode for PUBG: Battlegrounds is launching on May 13 for PC (Steam) and on May 21 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: PUBG: Battlegrounds x Payday - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Europa Universalis 5: Fate of the Phoenix immersion pack is available now on PC. Watch the Europa Universalis 5: Fate of the Phoenix launch trailer for this immersion pack which allows you to relive or reshape the fate of the Byzantine Empire. Guide the empire through crisis and transformation with new mechanics, historical paths and unique content. 

Navigate the Fate of the Phoenix disaster, to reawaken the glory of the Roman Empire or carve a new path in history. 

The Empire Endures, if you can lead it.
title: Europa Universalis 5: Fate of the Phoenix - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for IronOak Games' roguelike tabletop RPG, For The King 2. Boasting 7 replayable chapters, an infinite dungeon challenge mode, offline and online multiplayer and over 20 character classes! 

For the King 2 is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: For The King 2 - Official "Join The Fight" Trailer
